recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見中大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且深藍，邊緣長出多個像泡泡般的細胞質突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這是巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）的經典外觀。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Prominent cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods budding from the cell surface
Two blasts adherent to each other; a smaller atypical cell nearby
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round nuclei with fine chromatin, and scant deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The blasts display distinctive cytoplasmic blebs and bud-like projections at the cell margin, and two cells are clustered together. Platelets are sparse. Findings are suggestive of megakaryoblasts, as seen in acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry for CD41/CD42b/CD61 is required.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may show small blebs but lack megakaryocytic markers; immunophenotyping (CD41/CD61 vs TdT/CD19/CD3) is required.
Myeloblasts usually have less cytoplasmic budding and express MPO or CD13/CD33 rather than CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells tend to form cohesive clumps and are CD45 negative, whereas megakaryoblasts circulate singly and express platelet glycoproteins.

ddx.dx: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinguished by constitutional trisomy 21, GATA1 mutation and neonatal onset.
